payload.title: Observability completeness: native sync telemetry (Swift/Android) + diagnostics/devtools
payload.description:
The TypeScript client emits WebSocket sync spans/metrics via OTel; Swift/Android expose dependency-light hooks for analytics track() only and do NOT bundle native OTel SDKs — native sync-socket telemetry is pending (status.md:55-56; authoring.md:366-369).

Also harden developer diagnostics/devtools (hardening spec:1275-1311): schema, subscriptions, cursors, pending appends, errors, connection state, cache metadata, sync time exposed via CLI (frick doctor/inspect) and client snapshots. Fricken Dashboard exists; the structured diagnostics data model + CLI tooling need completion. Size: M.
